purpose: Part 3/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 029; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the current 130-record checkpoint.

items/dragons-draught-silver-380.name: Dragon's Draught, Silver
items/dragons-draught-silver-380.effectSummary: A dragon or creature with the dragonblood subtype that drinks this draught can use its breath weapon once during the next hour as a standard action: 50-foot cone, 12d8 cold, Reflex DC 25 half. Drinking a second dragon's draught before using the first discards the first draught's effect.

items/dragons-draught-white-374.name: Dragon's Draught, White
items/dragons-draught-white-374.effectSummary: A dragon or creature with the dragonblood subtype that drinks this draught can use its breath weapon once during the next hour as a standard action: 30-foot cone, 6d6 cold, Reflex DC 23 half. Drinking a second dragon's draught before using the first discards the first draught's effect.

items/dust-of-dullness.name: Dust of Dullness
items/dust-of-dullness.effectSummary: One dose can be poured on one target or hurled as a 10-foot cone; a single target takes -4 on its Fortitude save. Each living creature touched must make Fortitude DC 13 or roll 1d6, with cumulative effects lasting 1d6 hours: 1 taste dulled (-4 on saves against ingested toxins); 2 smell dulled (lose scent); 3 hearing dulled (deafened); 4 touch dulled (-2 on attack rolls and Dexterity-based skill checks); 5 sight dulled (blinded); 6 sixth sense dulled (cannot cast divination spells and -4 on Will saves).

items/chromatic-rod-637.name: Chromatic Rod [Relic]
items/chromatic-rod-637.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, neutral-evil, or chaotic-neutral wielder, the rod functions as a +1 morningstar and can have one of corrosive, frost, flaming, or shock at a time, selectable by command word. With the relic connection to Tiamat, each listed spell-like ability is usable once per day when the corresponding divine-slot/True-Believer-and-HD threshold is met: 5th-level slot/9 HD grants wall of ice (300-ft. range, up to twenty 10-ft. squares) and insect plague (1,200-ft. range, six adjacent swarms); 7th-level slot/13 HD grants dominate person (75 ft., Will DC 20), find the path (200 minutes), and veil (Will DC 21).

items/chylnoths-coronet.name: Chylnoth's Coronet
items/chylnoths-coronet.effectSummary: The coronet functions as a helm of underwater action and grants freedom of movement for up to 1 hour per day, usable nonconsecutively. On command its sea-cat figurine animates as a figurine of wondrous power; it can be summoned twice per week and remains for up to 6 hours per use.

items/crown-of-the-north-wind.name: Crown of the North Wind
items/crown-of-the-north-wind.effectSummary: While worn, the crown grants +2 enhancement to Charisma and a continuous cloak of bravery effect that can be dismissed or resumed as a standard action. A wearer with an acid, cold, fire, or lightning breath weapon can replace it with the corresponding metallic-dragon secondary breath: acid -> copper slow gas; cold -> silver paralyzing gas; fire -> brass sleep gas or gold weakening gas; lightning -> bronze repulsion gas. For age-dependent effects, use the wearer's age category or young, whichever is more favorable.

items/cube-force-293.name: Cube of Force
items/cube-force-293.effectSummary: The cube creates a 10-foot-on-a-side mobile wall-of-force screen around its possessor. It has 36 charges renewed daily; pressing a face activates that screen or deactivates it. Face 1 costs 1 charge/minute, max speed 30 ft., keeps out gases/wind; face 2 costs 2, speed 20, keeps out nonliving matter; face 3 costs 3, speed 15, keeps out living matter; face 4 costs 4, speed 10, keeps out magic; face 5 costs 6, speed 10, keeps out all things; face 6 deactivates at no cost. While active, attacks dealing over 30 damage drain 1 extra charge per full 10 damage beyond 30. The following effects also drain charges and cannot be cast into or out of the cube: horn of blasting 6, wall of fire 2, passwall 3, disintegrate 6, phase door 5, prismatic spray 7.

items/deck-illusions-298.name: Deck of Illusions
items/deck-illusions-298.effectSummary: A full deck has 34 single-use cards. Drawing a random card and throwing it to the ground creates a major image of that card's creature; the figment lasts until dispelled, stays within 30 feet of the landing point, otherwise acts as if real, and obeys the drawer. Picking up the card instantly dispels the image; when the illusion is dispelled the card becomes blank. A random deck is complete on d% 11-100 or is missing 1d20 cards on 01-10. items/dorjes-690.name: Dorjes
items/dorjes-690.effectSummary: A dorje holds one psionic power and begins with 50 charges; each use expends one charge, and an empty dorje becomes mundane crystal. Activation is power-trigger, normally a standard action that does not provoke, or the power's longer manifesting time if applicable; the user must hold and point it and must have the power on their class list. Standard dorjes use the minimum manifester level and cannot be augmented by the wielder; a creator may make one at a higher manifester level, no more than five above the minimum, in which case augmentable powers are pre-augmented up to that manifester level and normal augmentation limits. Typical physical stats are AC 7, 7 hp, hardness 8, break DC 18. On random generation, 01-30 gives a mentally imprinted command thought and 31-100 no special quality. items/elixir-of-draconic-essence.name: Elixir of Draconic Essence
items/elixir-of-draconic-essence.effectSummary: For 10 minutes after drinking, the user gains +4 enhancement to existing natural armor, +8 enhancement Strength, +4 enhancement Constitution, +2 enhancement Intelligence, +2 enhancement Charisma, two claws and a bite with damage by size, fly 60 ft. (average), immunity to the energy of the chosen dragon essence, and a 6d6 breath weapon usable once every 1d4 rounds (Reflex DC 14 half). Black: 60-ft. acid line; blue: 60-ft. lightning line; green: 30-ft. acid-gas cone; red: 30-ft. fire cone; white: 30-ft. cold cone. Natural-attack damage table (claw/bite) by size: Fine 1/-; Diminutive 1d2/1; Tiny 1d3/1d2; Medium 1d6/1d4; Large 1d8/1d6; Huge 2d6/1d8; Gargantuan 3d6/2d6; Colossal 4d6/3d6.
